T: Snowed in. Fed up. Back for more.
D: John McClane fights terrorists who've taken over a snowed-in Washington airport on Christmas Eve.
P: Serve dinner while Holly's plane circles overhead, running out of fuel.
S: Warm buttermilk biscuits with Dijon butter and thin sliced ham
Buttermilk biscuits split warm and filled with thin slices of salty ham and a smear of mustard butter.
stuck at the airport on Christmas Eve

Wings dried and baked until crackling, tossed in hot sauce melted with butter, served with blue cheese dip and celery sticks. Pat 1.2kg chicken wings dry, toss with 2 tsp baking powder and 1 tsp salt and leave uncovered in the fridge for a few hours. Bake on a rack at 220C for 45 minutes, turning once, until crisp. Melt 60g butter with 120ml hot sauce and toss the wings through. Mix 100g crumbled blue cheese with 100g sour cream, 2 tbsp mayo and a squeeze of lemon. Serve with 4 celery sticks cut into batons.
Crisp potato skins with cheddar and bacon, sour cream and chives
Bake small potatoes, halve, scoop, brush with butter, crisp at 220C, fill with cheddar and bacon, bake again, sour cream and chives.
M: Virginia pulled pork rolls with slaw
Virginia barbecue, eaten standing up between fights

Pork shoulder rubbed with paprika and brown sugar, slow cooked until it pulls apart, tossed in tangy vinegar sauce and piled into soft rolls with crunchy slaw. Rub 1.5kg boneless pork shoulder with 2 tbsp smoked paprika, 2 tbsp brown sugar, 2 tsp salt and 1 tsp pepper. Roast covered at 150C for 4 hours until it pulls apart. Simmer 150ml apple cider vinegar, 2 tbsp brown sugar, 1 tsp chilli flakes and 2 tbsp tomato sauce for 3 minutes and toss through the shredded pork. Mix shredded cabbage and carrot with 3 tbsp mayo and a splash of vinegar. Pile into 8 soft rolls with the slaw.
Slow braised beef chuck and mince with tomatoes and kidney beans, sour cream

Beef chuck and mince browned, braised 2.5 hours with onion, chilli, cumin, tomato and kidney beans. Brown 600g diced beef chuck and 400g mince. Add 1 onion, 2 tbsp chilli powder and 1 tsp cumin, then 2 tins tomatoes. Braise 2.5 hours, adding 2 tins kidney beans for the last 30 minutes. Serve with sour cream and grated cheddar.
W: Ginger and cinnamon cookies made with brown sugar and golden syrup
Gingerbread dough (butter, brown sugar, golden syrup, ginger, cinnamon) rolled, cut into planes and snowflakes, baked at 180C for 10 minutes, iced.
K: Egg yolk, milk and cream eggnog with bourbon and nutmeg

Rich homemade eggnog of milk, cream, egg yolks and nutmeg, spiked with bourbon, chilled and served in tumblers with fresh nutmeg grated over. Whisk 4 egg yolks with 80g caster sugar until pale. Warm 500ml milk and 250ml cream with a pinch of nutmeg until steaming, then slowly whisk into the yolks. Return to the pan and stir over low heat for 4 minutes until it coats a spoon, without boiling. Cool, stir in 120ml bourbon and chill 2 hours. Pour into tumblers and grate fresh nutmeg on top.

s.note: Warm buttermilk biscuits with Dijon butter and thin sliced ham
s.how: Rub 100g cold butter into 300g self-raising flour with 1 tsp salt, stir in 200ml buttermilk and pat 2cm thick. Cut 12 rounds and bake at 220C for 12 minutes. Split warm, spread with 40g butter mixed with 1 tbsp Dijon and fill with 200g thin-sliced leg ham.

s.note: Crisp potato skins with cheddar and bacon, sour cream and chives
s.how: Bake 8 small potatoes at 200C for 45 minutes. Halve, scoop out most of the flesh and brush with 40g butter. Crisp at 220C for 10 minutes, fill with 150g cheddar and 150g cooked bacon and bake 5 more minutes. Top with sour cream and chives.

m.note: Slow braised beef chuck and mince with tomatoes and kidney beans, sour cream
m.how: Brown 600g diced beef chuck and 400g mince. Add 1 onion, 2 tbsp chilli powder and 1 tsp cumin, then 2 tins tomatoes. Braise 2.5 hours, adding 2 tins kidney beans for the last 30 minutes. Serve with sour cream and grated cheddar.

w.note: Ginger and cinnamon cookies made with brown sugar and golden syrup
w.how: Melt 125g butter, 100g brown sugar and 100g golden syrup. Stir in 300g flour, 2 tsp ginger, 1 tsp cinnamon and half a tsp bicarb. Chill an hour, roll and cut into planes and snowflakes. Bake at 180C for 10 minutes and ice with 200g icing sugar.
